content:
Here is an interactive tour for the Rocco engine on the web!

Please shout-out if there if there are issues or anything is unclear.

https://pixelsprout.dev/projects/rocco/tour/01-window/
Or would it be possible to add some kind of fallback software rendering?
Yeah at this stage unfortunately. I use some rendering features that are only supported with this API. Mainly Clustered forward lighting. Ideally I would have the fallback use a different technique.
